central_claim: Democrat Stacey Abrams will protect abortion rights in Georgia, while Republican Governor Brian Kemp has taken them away by signing a 6-week ban.
intended_effect: To frame the political choice on abortion as a clear contrast, encouraging support for Stacey Abrams and disapproval of Brian Kemp.
